def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    top=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=0 for v in row)>=3)
    cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v]
    colors=[grid[top][c] for c in cols]
    for idx,(c,color) in enumerate(zip(cols,colors)):
        # Extend each top-pattern stripe; a right-side marker bounds its stripe at its row,
        # while a left-side marker supplies a horizontal crossbar.
        markers=[(r,k) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for k,v in enumerate(row) if v==color and not (r==top and k==c)]
        mr=markers[0] if markers else None
        end=h-1
        if mr:
            r,k=mr
            if k>c: end=r
        for rr in range(top,min(h,end+1)):
            out[rr][c]=color
        if mr:
            r,k=mr
            if k<c:
                for x in range(k,c+1): out[r][x]=color
            elif k>c:
                for x in range(c,k+1): out[r][x]=color
    return out
